title: Simultaneous distributed sensing and communication enabled by space and wavelength division multiplexing in a field-deployed seven-core fiber

optical_front_end: Ultra-narrow-linewidth NKT E15 sensing laser, three AOM/EDFA/optical-filter probe paths, WDM combiners, circulators, fan-in/fan-out for seven-core fiber, polarization-diversity coherent sensing receiver and 500-MSa/s DAQ.
